name: Syncart
description: A vendor-specific (Synapse) custom Drupal Commerce cart module: a JSON/AJAX shopping cart, favorites, donation mode, admin order-number sequence reset, and an admin-generated checkout link, built on top of commerce_cart/commerce_checkout/commerce_order. Part of the syncart/synhelper suite.
project_description: Syncart is a Synapse-authored custom Drupal Commerce cart layer. It replaces the standard add-to-cart/checkout UX with a JSON/AJAX cart: dedicated endpoints add single or multiple product variations, change quantity, set per-item notes, remove items, repeat a past order, and refresh stock. It ships a cart block, a favorites (wishlist) page driven by a browser cookie, a donation mode that creates on-the-fly priced variations, a receipt/checkout template set with translations (en/es/kk/ru), a settings form, an admin page to reset Commerce order-number sequences, and an admin-generated hashed checkout link that lets a customer resume a specific order. Optional submodules add order-status taxonomy management, a POS terminal cookie/order type, and paragraph-based product features.
